definition: ئاخفتن یان کارەکێ نەجوان بەرامبەر کەسەکی.

definitionEnglish: A serious magazine or newspaper that is published regularly about a particular subject, or a written record of what you have done each day.

definitionEnglish: If someone is given permission to do something, they are allowed to do it.

definition: رێدان ب تشتەکی یان بەلگەیەکا فەرمی.
definitionEnglish: To allow something, or an official document that allows you to do something or go somewhere.

definition: تاکە مرۆڤەک.
definitionEnglish: A human being.

definition: تشتەکێ گرێدای ب کەسەکی ب خۆ ڤە.
definitionEnglish: Relating to or belonging to a single or particular person rather than to a group or an organization.

definition: کۆمەکا سیفەتان کو کەسەکی ژ یێن دی جودا دکەت.
definitionEnglish: The type of person you are, shown by the way you behave, feel, and think.

definition: ژ لایێ کەسەکی ب خۆ ڤە.
definitionEnglish: Used when you are giving your own opinion about something.
exampleKurdish: بۆ خۆم (ژ لایێ من ڤە)، ئەز دژی وێ مە.

definition: خەلکێ د رێکخراوەک یان سوپایەک دا کار دکەن.
definitionEnglish: The people who are employed in a company or organization, or in one of the armed forces.

definition: شێوازێ هزرکرن ل سەر بابەتەکی.
definitionEnglish: A particular way of considering something.

definition: رازی کرنا کەسەکی بۆ ئەنجامدانا کارەکی ب رێکا ئاخفتنێ.
definitionEnglish: To make someone do or believe something by giving them a good reason to do it or by talking to them and making them believe it.

definition: ئاژەلەکێ کو تو ل مال خودان دکەی بۆ کەیفخۆشییێ.
definitionEnglish: An animal that is kept in the home as a companion and treated with affection.

definition: شلەمەنیەک بۆ کارپێکرنا مەکینەیێن ترۆمبێلان.
definitionEnglish: A liquid obtained from petroleum, used as fuel in car engines, etc.

definition: قۆناغەکا دیاریکری د ناڤ پرۆسەیەکێ دا.
definitionEnglish: A stage in a series of events or a period of development.
exampleEnglish: The first phase of the project.

definition: تشتەکێ رویددەت یان هەبیت، ب تایبەتی تشتەکێ سەیر.
definitionEnglish: Something that exists and can be seen, felt, tasted, etc., especially something unusual or interesting.

definition: ڤەکۆلین ل سەر راستی و رامانا ژیانێ.
definitionEnglish: The use of reason in understanding such things as the nature of the real world and existence, the use and limits of knowledge, and the principles of moral judgment.

definition: ئامێرەک بۆ ئاخفتن دگەل کەسێن دوور.
definitionEnglish: A device used for communicating with someone who is in another place by speaking or by using a computer.

definition: وێنەیەکێ کو ب کامیرایێ هاتیە گرتن.
definitionEnglish: A photograph.

definition: وێنەیەکێ کو ب رێکا کامیرایێ هاتیە دروستکرن.
definitionEnglish: A picture produced using a camera.

definition: کەسەکێ وێنەیان دگریت، ب تایبەتی وەک کار.
definitionEnglish: A person who takes photographs, either as a job or hobby.

definition: هونەر یان کارێ گرتنا وێنەیان.
definitionEnglish: The skill, job, or process of producing photographs.
exampleKurdish: ئەز ب وێنەگرییێ یێ سەرقالم (حەز دکەم).

definition: کۆمەکا پەیڤان کو رامانەکێ ددەن.
definitionEnglish: A group of words that is part of a sentence.

definition: تشتەکێ گرێدای ب لەشی ڤە، نە ب ئەقلی.
definitionEnglish: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind.

definition: ب شێوەیەکێ جەستەیی.
definitionEnglish: In a way that relates to the body or someone's appearance.
exampleKurdish: ژ لایێ جەستەیی ڤە یێ رێک و پێکە.

definition: پزیشکەک، ب تایبەتی یێ کو نەشتەرگەریێ ناکەت.
definitionEnglish: A medical doctor, especially one who has general skill and is not a surgeon.

definition: زانستێ ڤەکۆلین ل سەر ماددە و وزەیێ.
definitionEnglish: The scientific study of matter and energy and the effect that they each have on the other.

definition: ئامێرەکێ مۆسیقایێ یێ مەزن کو ب پەنجەیان دهێتە ژەنین.
definitionEnglish: A large musical instrument with a row of black and white keys that are pressed with the fingers to play notes.

definition: هەلبژارتنا تشتەکی ژ ناڤ کۆمەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To choose something from a group of things.

definition: وێنەیەک یان تابلۆیەک.
definitionEnglish: A drawing, painting, photograph, etc.

definition: پشکەک ژ تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: A part of something.

definition: ئاژەلەکێ کێویلە یان یێ مالێ.
definitionEnglish: A pink or black animal with short legs and a flat nose.

definition: کۆمەکا تشتان کو ل سەر ئێک هاتینە دانان.
definitionEnglish: A mass of something that has been placed somewhere.

definition: پارچەیەکا بچویک و رەق یا دەرمانی کو دهێتە قوتدان.
definitionEnglish: A small, hard piece of medicine that you swallow.

definition: کەسەکێ فرۆکەیێ دهاژۆت.
definitionEnglish: A person who flies an aircraft.

definition: پارچەیەکا بچویک و تیژ یا ئاسنی بۆ پێکڤە نوساندنا تشتان.
definitionEnglish: A small, thin, pointed piece of metal with a head, used for fastening pieces of cloth, paper, etc. together.

definition: رەنگەکێ د ناڤبەرا سپی و سۆر دا.
definitionEnglish: A pale red color.

definition: کەسەکێ ئێکەم جار کارەکێ دکەت یان داهێنانەکێ دکەت.
definitionEnglish: A person who is among the first to explore or settle a new country or area, or a person who is among the first to study or develop something.

definition: لوولەیەک بۆ ڤەگوهاستنا ئاڤ یان غازێ.
definitionEnglish: A tube inside which liquid or gas flows from one place to another.

definition: کونەکا مەزن د عەردی دا.
definitionEnglish: A large hole in the ground, or a slightly low area in any surface.

definition: جهێ یاریێ یان ئاستێ بلندی و نزمییا دەنگی.
definitionEnglish: An area painted with lines for playing a particular sport, or the level or degree of something.

definition: هەستەکێ خەمگینیێ بۆ کەسەکی یان تشتەکێ مخابن.
definitionEnglish: A feeling of sadness or sympathy for someone else's unhappiness or difficult situation.

definition: ناوچەیەک یان جهەکێ دیاریکری.
definitionEnglish: An area, town, building, etc.

definition: تشتەکێ سادە یان پارچە عەردەکێ تەخت.
definitionEnglish: Not decorated in any way; with nothing added, or a large area of flat land.

definition: کۆمەکا بڕیاران ل سەر هندێ کا دێ تشتەک چەوا هێتە ئەنجامدان.
definitionEnglish: A set of decisions about how to do something in the future.

definition: ئامێرەکێ گەشتکرنێ یێ ب هەوای دا دچیت.
definitionEnglish: An aircraft with wings and one or more engines.

definition: تشتەکێ گەردونی یێ مەزن کو ل دەورێ ستێرەکێ دزڤڕیت.
definitionEnglish: An extremely large, round mass of matter and gas, such as the earth, that moves in a circle around the sun or another star.

definition: کەسەکێ پلانان دادڕێژیت یان پەرتووکەک بۆ رێکخستنا دەمی.
definitionEnglish: A person who makes plans, or a book or document used for recording and organizing information.

definition: پرۆسەیا هزرکرنێ ل سەر چالاکییێن پێدڤی بۆ گەهشتن ب ئارمانجەکێ.
definitionEnglish: The act of deciding how to do something.

definition: زیندەوەرەکێ کەسک کو د عەردی دا شین دبیت یان کارگەیەکا مەزن.
definitionEnglish: A living thing that grows in earth, in water, or on other plants, usually has a stem, leaves, roots, and flowers, and produces seeds, or a factory or place where power is produced or an industrial process takes place.

definition: ماددەیەکێ دەستکرد کو بۆ دروستکرنا گەلەک تشتان دهێتە بکارئینان.
definitionEnglish: An artificial substance that can be shaped when soft into many different forms and has many different uses.

definition: قاپەکێ تەخت بۆ خوارنێ.
definitionEnglish: A flat, usually round, dish that you put food on.

definition: جهەکێ بلند بۆ ئاخفتنێ یان جهێ راوەستانا شەمەندەفەرێ.
definitionEnglish: A flat raised area or structure.

definition: ئەنجامدانا چالاکیەکێ بۆ کەیفخۆشییێ یان کارەکێ شانۆیی.
definitionEnglish: When you play, you spend time doing an enjoyable activity, or a piece of writing that is intended to be acted in a theater or on radio or television.

definition: کەسەکێ یارییێ دکەت یان ئامێرەکێ مۆسیقایێ دژەنت.
definitionEnglish: Someone who takes part in a game or sport, or someone who plays a musical instrument.

definition: تشتەکێ کو کەیفا مروڤی پێ بهێت.
definitionEnglish: Enjoyable, attractive, friendly, or easy to like.

definition: پەیڤەک بۆ داخوازکرنا تشتەکی ب رێز ڤە.
definitionEnglish: Used to be polite when asking for something.

definition: هەستکرن ب کەیفخۆشی و رازیبوونێ.
definitionEnglish: Happy or satisfied.

definition: هەستێ کەیفخۆشی و رازیبوونێ.
definitionEnglish: A feeling of happiness, enjoyment, or satisfaction.

definition: کۆژمەکێ زۆر یێ تشتەکی، پتر ژ پێدڤی.
definitionEnglish: The state of having enough or more than enough, or a large amount.

definition: چیرۆکا سەرەکی یا پەرتووکەکێ یان پیلانەکا نهێنی.
definitionEnglish: The story of a book, movie, play, etc., or a secret plan made by several people to do something that is wrong, harmful, or not legal.

definition: ئامێرەکێ کارەبێ بۆ گەهاندنا ئامێران ب کارەبێ ڤە.
definitionEnglish: A small plastic object with two or three metal pins that fits into the holes of an electric outlet and connects an electrical device to the electricity supply.

definition: نیشانا کۆکرنێ (+) یان تشتەکێ باش یێ زێدە.
definitionEnglish: Added to, or an advantage or a good feature.

definition: کیسەکێ بچویک د جلکان دا بۆ هەلگرتنا تشتان.
definitionEnglish: A small bag that is sewn into or onto a piece of clothing so that you can carry things in it.

definition: پارچە نڤیسینەک کو ب ریتم و هەست دهێتە نڤیسین.
definitionEnglish: A piece of writing in which the words are arranged in separate lines, often ending in rhyme, and are chosen for their sound and for the images and ideas they suggest.

definition: کەسەکێ هەلبەستان دنڤیسیت.
definitionEnglish: A person who writes poems.

definition: هونەرێ نڤیسینا هەلبەستان.
definitionEnglish: Poems in general as a form of literature.

definition: خالەکا بچویک یان رامانا سەرەکی یا ئاخفتنەکێ.
definitionEnglish: An idea, opinion, or piece of information that is said or written, or a small, round mark.

definition: تشتەکێ سەرێ وی یێ تیژ بیت.
definitionEnglish: A pointed object has a thin, sharp end.

definition: ماددەیەک کو دبیتە ئەگەرێ نەخۆشی یان مرنێ ئەگەر بهێتە خوارن.
definitionEnglish: A substance that can make people or animals ill or kill them if they eat or drink it.

definition: تشتەکێ ژەهر تێدا بیت.
definitionEnglish: Very harmful and able to cause illness or death.

definition: پارچە دار یان ئاسنەکا درێژ یان جەمسەرێن زەویێ.
definitionEnglish: A long, thin stick of wood or metal, often used to hold something up, or either of the two points at the very top and bottom of the earth.

definition: رێکخراوەکا فەرمی بۆ پاراستنا یاسایێ.
definitionEnglish: The official organization that is responsible for making sure that people obey the law.

definition: پیاوەک کو د پۆلیس دا کار دکەت.
definitionEnglish: A male member of a police force.

definition: کۆمەکا یاسا یان بریاران کو رێکخراوەک بکار دئینیت.
definitionEnglish: A set of ideas or a plan of what to do in particular situations that has been agreed to officially by a group of people, a business organization, a government, or a political party.

definition: پاقژکرنا تشتەکی هەتا دبریقیت.
definitionEnglish: To rub something using a piece of cloth or a brush to make it shiny and clean.

definition: کەسەکێ ب رێز و ئەدەب رەفتارێ دکەت.
definitionEnglish: Behaving in a way that is socially correct and shows understanding of and care for other people's feelings.

definition: ب شێوەیەکێ ب ئەدەب.
definitionEnglish: In a polite way.
exampleKurdish: وی ب رێز ڤە پرسیار کر.

definition: تشتەکێ گرێدای ب حکومەت یان سیاسەتێ ڤە.
definitionEnglish: Relating to politics.

definition: کەسەکێ د سیاسەتێ دا کار دکەت.
definitionEnglish: A member of a government or law-making organization.

definition: چالاکییێن گرێدای ب حکومەت و دەستهەلاتێ ڤە.
definitionEnglish: The activities of the government, members of law-making organizations, or people who try to influence the way a country is governed.

definition: پرسیارکرن ژ خەلکی ل سەر هزرێن وان یان دەنگدان.
definitionEnglish: A study in which people are asked for their opinions about a particular subject or person.

definition: پیسکرنا هەوا، ئاڤ، یان عەردی ب ماددەیێن زیانبەخش.
definitionEnglish: To make an area or substance, such as air or water, dirty and harmful to people, animals, and plants, especially by adding harmful chemicals.

definition: تەماشاکرنا تشتەکی ب هووری بۆ هندێ پتر زانیاریان ل سەر بزانی.
definitionEnglish: To watch carefully the way something happens or the way someone does something, especially in order to learn more about it.
exampleEnglish: The role of scientists is to observe and describe the world.
exampleKurdish: رۆڵێ زانایان ئەوە کو چاڤدێرییا جیهانێ بکەن و وەسف بکەن.

definition: تشتەک کو رێگریێ ل تە دکەت کارەکی ئەنجام بدەی.
definitionEnglish: Something that blocks you so that movement, going forward, or action is prevented or made more difficult.
exampleEnglish: The biggest obstacle to success is fear of failure.
exampleKurdish: مەزنترین ئاستەنگ بۆ سەرکەفتنێ ترسا ژ شکەستنێ یە.

definition: بدەستڤەئینانا تشتەکی، ب تایبەتی ب رێکا بزاڤێ.
definitionEnglish: To get something, especially by asking for it, buying it, working for it, or producing it from something else.
exampleEnglish: In the second experiment they obtained a very clear result.
exampleKurdish: د تاقیکرنا دووێ دا وان ئەنجامەکێ گەلەک روون بدەستڤە ئینا.

definition: تشتەکێ ب سناهی بهێتە دیتن یان تێگەهشتن.
definitionEnglish: Easy to see, recognize, or understand.
exampleEnglish: It's obvious that she doesn't like him.
exampleKurdish: یا ئاشکرایە کو ئەو وێ حەژێ ناکەت.

definition: دەمەکێ تایبەت کو تێدا رویدانەک چێدبیت.
definitionEnglish: A particular time, especially when something happens or has happened.
exampleEnglish: We met on several occasions to discuss the issue.
exampleKurdish: ئەم ل سەر چەندین هەلکەفتان کۆمبووین بۆ بەحسکرنا وی بابەتی.

definition: چێبوونا تشتەکی، ب تایبەتی تشتەکێ نەپلان بۆ هاتیە دان.
definitionEnglish: (Especially of accidents and other unexpected events) to happen.
exampleEnglish: An accident occurred at the intersection.

definition: تشتەکێ جێواز بیت ژ یێ ئاسایی ب شێوازەکێ کو تێگەهشتن لێ ب زەحمەت بیت.
definitionEnglish: Strange or unexpected.
exampleEnglish: It's odd that no one answered the phone.
exampleKurdish: یا نامۆیە کو کەسێ بەرسڤا تەلەفۆنێ نەدا.

definition: کارەکێ دژی یاسایێ بیت.
definitionEnglish: An illegal act; a crime.
exampleEnglish: Driving without a license is a serious offence.

definition: تشتەکێ ببیتە ئەگەرێ دلگرانکرنا کەسەکی.
definitionEnglish: Causing someone to feel deeply hurt, upset, or angry.
exampleEnglish: I find her remarks deeply offensive.
exampleKurdish: من تێبینیێن وێ ب گەلەک بریندارکەر دیتن.

definition: تشتەکێ ژ لایێ کەسەکێ خودان دەسهەلات یان رێکخراوەکێ ڤە هاتیە پەسەندکرن.
definitionEnglish: Relating to a position of responsibility.

definition: تشتەکێ بەردەوام بیت و نەهاتیە ب دوماهی ئینان.
definitionEnglish: Continuing to exist or develop, or happening at the present time.
exampleEnglish: There is an ongoing investigation into the cause of the fire.
exampleKurdish: ڤەکۆلینەکا بەردەوام هەیە ل سەر ئەگەرێ ئاگری.

definition: کارکرنا ئامیرەکی یان سیستەمەکی.
definitionEnglish: (To cause) to work, be in action, or have an effect.
exampleEnglish: How do you operate this machine?
exampleKurdish: تو چەوا ڤێ ئامیرێ بکار دئێخی؟

definition: کارەکێ پزیشکی یان کارەکێ رێکخراو.
definitionEnglish: The fact of operating or being active.
exampleEnglish: He had an operation on his knee.
exampleKurdish: وی نەشتەرگەریەک بۆ چۆکێ خۆ کر.

definition: کەسەکێ دژی تە بیت د یاریەکێ یان کێبڕکێیەکێ دا.
definitionEnglish: A person who disagrees with something and speaks against it or tries to change it.
exampleEnglish: He defeated his opponent in the final match.
exampleKurdish: وی بەرهنگارێ خۆ د یارییا دوماهیێ دا شکاند.

definition: دەمەکێ گونجای بۆ ئەنجامدانا کارەکی.
definitionEnglish: An occasion or situation that makes it possible to do something that you want to do or have to do, or the possibility of doing something.
exampleEnglish: Don't miss this opportunity to study abroad.
exampleKurdish: ڤێ دەلیڤەیا خواندنێ ل دەرڤەی وەلاتی ژ دەست نەدە.

definition: راوەستان دژی پلانەکێ یان هزرەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To disagree with something or someone, often by speaking or fighting against them.
exampleEnglish: Many people oppose the new law.
exampleKurdish: گەلەک خەلک دژی یاسایا نوو نە.

definition: کەس یان گروپێن دژی حکومەتێ یان پلانەکێ بن.
definitionEnglish: Strong disagreement with, or protest against, something such as a plan, law, or system.
exampleEnglish: The proposal met with strong opposition.
exampleKurdish: پێشنیار تووشی دژایەتیەکا ب هێز بوو.

definition: تشتەک تو دشێی هەلبژێری د ناڤبەرا چەند تشتان دا.
definitionEnglish: One thing that can be chosen from a set of possibilities, or the freedom to make a choice.
exampleEnglish: We have several options for dinner.
exampleKurdish: مە چەندین هەلبژارتن بۆ شێڤێ هەنە.

definition: تشتەکێ یێ سادە بیت و چو تشتێ تایبەت تێدا نەبیت.
definitionEnglish: Not different or special or unexpected in any way; usual.
exampleEnglish: It was just an ordinary day.

definition: گروپەکێ خەلکی کو بۆ ئارمانجەکا دیارکری کار دکەن.
definitionEnglish: A group of people who work together in an organized way for a shared purpose.
exampleEnglish: She works for a non-profit organization.
exampleKurdish: ئەو د رێکخراوەکا بێ مفا دا کار دکەت.

definition: دانانا تشتان ب رێکوپێکی یان ئامادەکرنا رویدانەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To make arrangements for something to happen.
exampleEnglish: They are organizing a surprise party.

definition: دەسپێکا تشتەکی یان جهێ تشتەک ژێ هاتی.
definitionEnglish: The beginning or cause of something.
exampleEnglish: What is the origin of this word?

definition: تشتەکێ کو یێ ئێکێ بیت و نەهاتبیتە کۆپیکردن.
definitionEnglish: Existing since the beginning, or being the first form of something.

definition: بکاردهێت بۆ دیارکرنا ئەنجامەکێ دی ئەگەر کارەک نەهێتە کرن.
definitionEnglish: Used after an order or suggestion to show what the result will be if you do not follow it.
exampleEnglish: Hurry up, otherwise we'll be late.
exampleKurdish: بلەزینە، ئەگەر نە دێ درەنگ کەڤین.

definition: ئەنجامێ دوماهیێ یێ رویدانەکێ یان کردارەکێ.
definitionEnglish: A result or effect of an action, situation, etc.
exampleEnglish: We are waiting for the outcome of the election.

definition: وەسفەکا کورت یا خالێن سەرەکی یێن پلانەکێ یان چیرۆکەکێ.
definitionEnglish: The main shape or edge of something, without any details.
exampleEnglish: She gave a brief outline of the project.
exampleKurdish: وێ کورتەیەکا کورت ل سەر پرۆژەی پێشکێش کر.

definition: بڕێ بەرهەمێ کو کۆمپانیەک یان ئامیرەک چێدکەت.
definitionEnglish: An amount of something produced by a person, machine, factory, country, etc.
exampleEnglish: The factory has increased its output.

definition: تشتەکێ گەلەک باش بیت یان نەهاتبیتە چارەسەرکرن (وەک قەرز).
definitionEnglish: Clearly very much better than what is usual.

definition: هەمی پشکێن تشتەکی ب هەڤڕا.
definitionEnglish: In general rather than in particular, or including all the people or things in a particular group or situation.

definition: شیانێن چارەسەرکرنا کێشەیەکێ یان ئاستەنگەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To defeat or succeed in controlling or dealing with something.
exampleEnglish: She managed to overcome her shyness.
exampleKurdish: وێ شیا سەرکەفتنێ ب سەر شەرمینییا خۆ دا بینیت.

definition: نەبینینا تشتەکی یان ب ئەنقەست پشتگوێ خستن.
definitionEnglish: To fail to notice or consider something or someone.
exampleEnglish: I think there is one detail we overlooked.

definition: تشتەکێ کو بەری دەمەکێ کورت رویدایە یان هاتیە دروستکرن.
definitionEnglish: Happening or starting from a short time ago.

definition: د دەمەکێ کورت یێ بوری دا.
definitionEnglish: Not long ago.
exampleKurdish: من ئەو ل ڤان دوماهییان دیت.

definition: جهێ پێشوازیکردن ل مێڤانان یان شێوازێ وەرگرتنا تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: The place in a hotel or office building where people go when they first arrive, or the way in which people react to something.

definition: کەسەکێ کارێ وی پێشوازیکردن ل مێڤانانە د ئۆفیسەکێ یان هۆتێلەکێ دا.
definitionEnglish: A person who works in a place such as a hotel or office and helps people who arrive.

definition: کۆمەکا رێنماییان بۆ چێکرنا خوارنەکێ.
definitionEnglish: A set of instructions telling you how to prepare and cook food, including a list of what food is needed for this.

definition: کەسەکێ تشتەکی وەردگریت.
definitionEnglish: A person who receives something.

definition: هزرکردن یان باوەری هەبوون ب تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: To think or believe.
exampleKurdish: ئەز وا دبینم (هزر دکەم) کو یا ڕاستە.

definition: کردارا ناسینەڤەیا کەسەکی یان قەبوولکردنا راستییەکێ.
definitionEnglish: The fact of knowing who someone is or what something is because you have seen or heard them or it before, or public appreciation for a person's achievements.

definition: ناسینەڤەیا کەسەکی یان تشتەکی ژبەر کو تە بەری نوکە دیتیە.
definitionEnglish: To know someone or something because you have seen or heard him or her or it before.

definition: گۆتنا هندێ کو تشتەک یێ باشە و پێدڤییە بهێتە بکارئینان.
definitionEnglish: To suggest that someone or something would be good or suitable for a particular job or purpose.

definition: ئەو پێشنیارا دهێتە کرن بۆ هندێ کو تشتەک یێ باشە.
definitionEnglish: A suggestion that something is good or suitable for a particular purpose or job.

definition: نڤیسینا پێزانینان بۆ پاراستنێ یان تۆمارکرنا دەنگی.
definitionEnglish: To store sounds or moving pictures using electronic equipment so that they can be heard or seen later, or a piece of information or a description of an event that is written on paper or stored on a computer.

definition: دەنگ یان وێنەیەکێ هاتیە تۆمارکرن.
definitionEnglish: A piece of music, moving pictures, or information that has been recorded.

definition: باشتر بوون پشتی نەخۆشییێ یان بدەستڤەئینانا تشتەکێ بەرزە بووی.
definitionEnglish: To become completely well again after an illness or injury, or to get back something that was lost or stolen.

definition: پرۆسەیا باشتر بوونێ یان ڤەگەراندنا تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: The process of becoming well again after an illness or injury, or the process of getting something back that was lost or stolen.

definition: پەیداکرنا کەسێن نوێ بۆ کارەکێ یان رێکخراوەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To persuade someone to work for a company or become a member of an organization, or a new member of an organization.

definition: پرۆسەیا پەیداکرنا کەسێن نوێ بۆ کارەکی.
definitionEnglish: The process of finding people to work for a company or become a new member of an organization.

definition: بکارئینانا تشتێن کەڤن بۆ دروستکرنا تشتێن نوو.
definitionEnglish: To sort and collect resources that would otherwise be thrown away and use them again.

definition: رەنگێ خوینێ یان تەماتەیێ.
definitionEnglish: The color of blood or tomatoes.

definition: بچویکترکرن یان کێمکرنا بڕ یان قەبارەیێ تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: To make something smaller in size, amount, degree, importance, or price.

definition: کردارا کێمکرنا تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: The act of making something smaller in size, amount, degree, importance, or price.

definition: تشتەکێ کو پێدڤی پێ نەمابیت یان کەسەکێ ژبەر نەمانا کاری هاتیە لادان.
definitionEnglish: Not needed or more than is needed, or (of a person) no longer employed because there is no more work available.
exampleKurdish: ژ کار هاتە لادان (ژبەر نەمانا کاری).

definition: بەحسکرنا تشتەکی یان فرێکرنا کەسەکی بۆ جهەکێ دی بۆ هاریکارییێ.
definitionEnglish: To talk or write about someone or something, or to send someone or something to a different place or person for help.

definition: بەحسکرنا تشتەکی یان کەسەکێ کو دشێت باسی لێهاتووییێن تە بکەت.
definitionEnglish: A mention of something, or a letter written by someone who knows you, giving information about your character or abilities.

definition: ڤەگەراندنا رووناهییێ یان هزرکرنا کویر ل سەر تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: To send back light, heat, or sound from a surface, or to think carefully about something.

definition: وێنەیێ د ئاوێنەیێ دا دیار دبیت یان هزرکرنەکا کویر.
definitionEnglish: An image that you can see in a mirror, glass, or water, or serious and careful thought.

definition: گۆڕینا تشتەکی بۆ هندێ کو باشتر لێ بهێت.
definitionEnglish: To make an improvement, especially by changing a person's behavior or the structure of something.

definition: کەسەکێ نەچار بووی وەلاتی خۆ بجهێلیت ژبەر شەڕی یان مەترسییێ.
definitionEnglish: A person who has escaped from their own country for political, religious, or economic reasons or because of a war.

definition: کردارا گۆتنا 'نە' بۆ تشتەکی یان ئەنجامنەدانا کارەکی.
definitionEnglish: The act of saying that you will not do or accept something.

definition: گۆتنا هندێ کو تو تشتەکی قەبوول ناکەی یان پاشماوەیێن تشتان.
definitionEnglish: To say that you will not do or accept something, or things that have been thrown away.

definition: هەبوونا رێزێ بۆ کەسەکی یان تەماشاکردنا تشتەکی ب شێوەیەکێ تایبەت.
definitionEnglish: To consider or have an opinion about something or someone, or respect and admiration.

definition: دەربارەی بابەتەکێ دیاریکری.
definitionEnglish: About.

definition: ئەنجامدانا تشتەکی بێی کو بارودۆخێن دی کارتێکرنێ ل تە بکەن.
definitionEnglish: Despite; not being affected by something.

definition: سیستەمەکێ حوکمڕانییێ یان شێوازەکێ رێکخستی یێ ژیانێ.
definitionEnglish: A particular government or a system or method of government.

definition: پشکەکا دیاریکری ژ عەردی یان وەلاتی.
definitionEnglish: A particular area or part of the world, or any of the large official areas into which a country is divided.

definition: تشتەکێ گرێدای ب ناوچەیەکا تایبەت ڤە.
definitionEnglish: Relating to or coming from a particular part of a country.

definition: تۆمارکردنا ناڤی یان پێزانینان د لیستەکا فەرمی دا.
definitionEnglish: To put information, especially your name, into an official list or record.

definition: کردارا تۆمارکردنا ناڤی یان تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: The act of recording a name or other information on an official list.

definition: هەستکردن ب خەمبارییێ ژبەر تشتەکێ تە کری یان نەکری.
definitionEnglish: A feeling of sadness about something sad or wrong or about a mistake that you have made, and a wish that it could have been different and better.

definition: تشتەکێ ب شێوەیەکێ بەردەوام و رێک و پێک رویدەت.
definitionEnglish: Happening or doing something often.

definition: ب شێوەیەکێ بەردەوام و د هەمان دەم دا.
definitionEnglish: Often.

definition: کۆنترۆلکردنا کارەکی ب رێکا یاسا و رێنماییان.
definitionEnglish: To control something, especially by making it work in a particular way or according to particular rules.

definition: یاسایەک یان رێنماییەک کو ژ لایێ دەستهەلاتێ ڤە دهێتە دان.
definitionEnglish: An official rule or the act of controlling something.

definition: پرۆسەیا ڤەگەراندنا کەسەکی بۆ ژیانەکا ئاسایی پشتی نەخۆشی یان زیندانێ.
definitionEnglish: The process of returning to a healthy or good way of life, or the process of helping someone to do this after they have been in prison, been very ill, etc.

definition: ئەنجامدانا راهێنانێ بۆ شانۆگەریەکێ یان کۆنسێرتەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To practice a play, a piece of music, etc. in order to prepare it for public performance.

definition: ئەو دەمێ پاشایەک یان شاژنەک حوکمێ وەلاتی دکەت.
definitionEnglish: The period of time when a king or queen rules a country.
exampleEnglish: During the reign of King Arthur.
exampleKurdish: د سەردەمێ حوکمڕانییا پاشا ئارسەر دا.

definition: زێدەکرنا هێزێ بۆ تشتەکی یان پشتگیریکردنا هزرەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To make something stronger, or to provide more proof or support for an idea.

definition: قەبوولنەکرنا تشتەکی یان کەسەکی.
definitionEnglish: To refuse to accept, use, or believe something or someone.

definition: کردارا قەبوولنەکرنا تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: The act of refusing to accept, use, or believe something or someone.

definition: نیشاندانا پەیوەندییا د ناڤبەرا دوو تشتان دا یان گێڕانەڤەیا چیرۆکەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To find or show the connection between two or more things, or to tell a story.

definition: تشتەکێ گرێدای ب تشتەکێ دی ڤە یان کەسێن ژ هەمان خێزان.
definitionEnglish: Connected.

definition: شێوازێ پەیوەندییا د ناڤبەرا دوو کەسان یان وەلاتیان دا.
definitionEnglish: The way in which two or more people, groups, countries, etc., feel and behave towards each other.

definition: پەیوەندییا د ناڤبەرا دوو کەسان دا، ب تایبەتی پەیوەندییا ئەڤینییێ.
definitionEnglish: The way in which two or more people or things are connected, or the state of being connected.

definition: کەسەکێ ژ خێزانا تە بیت یان تشتەکێ ب هەڤبەرکرن دگەل تشتەکێ دی بیت.
definitionEnglish: A member of your family, or being judged or measured in comparison with something else.

definition: ب هەڤبەرکرن دگەل تشتێن دی.
definitionEnglish: Quite, when compared to other people or things.

definition: راوەستان ژ کارەکی بۆ هندێ کو ئارام ببی.
definitionEnglish: To become less active and more calm and happy.

definition: ئەو دەمێ تو تێدا دحەسێیەوە و ئارام دبی.
definitionEnglish: The feeling of being relaxed.

definition: هەستکردن ب ئارامییێ و نەبوونا دڵەڕاوکێیێ.
definitionEnglish: Feeling happy and comfortable because nothing is worrying you.

definition: وەرگرتن و فرێکرنا پێزانینان یان جۆرەکێ پێشبڕکێیێ.
definitionEnglish: To repeat something you have heard, or to broadcast something, or a type of race.

definition: ئازادکرنا کەسەکی یان بەلاڤکردنا تشتەکێ نوو وەک فلم یان ستران.
definitionEnglish: To give freedom to someone or something, or to make a product, for example a book or a film, available for the public to buy or see.

definition: تشتەکێ گرێدای ب بابەتێ بەحس لێ دهێتە کرن.
definitionEnglish: Connected with what is happening or being discussed.

definition: سیفەتێ هندێ کو تشتەک یان کەسەک یێ جهێ باوەرییێ بیت.
definitionEnglish: The quality of being able to be trusted or believed because of working or behaving well.

definition: کەسەک یان تشتەک کو تو دشێی باوەریێ پێ بکەی.
definitionEnglish: Someone or something that is reliable can be trusted or believed because he, she, or it works or behaves well in the way you expect.

definition: هەستەکێ باش پشتی نەمانا ئازار یان خەمێ، یان هاریکاری بۆ هەژاران.
definitionEnglish: A feeling of happiness that something unpleasant has not happened or has ended, or food, money, or help that is given to people in help.

definition: کێمکرنا ئازارێ یان خەمێ.
definitionEnglish: To make an unpleasant feeling, such as pain or worry, less strong.

definition: باوەری هەبوون ب خودایەکێ یان کۆمەکا خودایان.
definitionEnglish: The belief in and worship of a god or gods, or any such system of belief and worship.

definition: تشتەکێ گرێدای ب ئایینی ڤە یان کەسەکێ خودان باوەری.
definitionEnglish: Relating to religion, or having a strong belief in a religion.

definition: نەڤیان یان دوودڵ بوون د ئەنجامدانا کارەکی دا.
definitionEnglish: Not wanting to do something and therefore slow to do it.

definition: باوەری هەبوون ب کەسەکی بۆ هاریکارییێ.
definitionEnglish: To trust someone or something or to expect him, her, or it to help you or do something.

definition: مان د هەمان بارودۆخ یان جهـ دا.
definitionEnglish: To stay in the same place or in the same condition.

definition: ئەو پشکا دمینیت پشتی پشکێن دی دهێنە برن.
definitionEnglish: The part of something that is left after the other parts have gone, been used, or been taken away.

definition: ئەو تشتێ هێشتا مای و نەتەمامیای.
definitionEnglish: Continuing to exist or be left after other parts or things have been used or taken away.

definition: ئەو تشتێن دمینن پشتی تشتەک دهێتە خرابکرن یان تەرمێ مرۆڤەکی.
definitionEnglish: Pieces or parts of something that continue to exist when most of it has been used, destroyed, or taken away, or the body of a dead person or animal.

definition: ئاخفتنەکا کورت دەربارەی تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: Something that you say or write which expresses an opinion, a thought, or a fact.

definition: تشتەکێ کو گەلەک یێ باش یان جیاواز بیت و سەرنجا خەلکی رابکێشیت.
definitionEnglish: Unusual or special and therefore surprising and worth mentioning.

definition: ب شێوەیەکێ کو مرۆڤی سەرسام دکەت.
definitionEnglish: In a way that is unusual or surprising and causes people to take notice.

definition: رێکارەک یان دەرمانەک بۆ چارەسەرکرنا نەخۆشییەکێ یان کێشەیەکێ.
definitionEnglish: A successful way of curing an illness or dealing with a problem or difficulty.

definition: هێلانا پێزانینان د مێشکی دا و ئینانا وان بۆ ناڤ بیرا خۆ.
definitionEnglish: To be able to bring back a piece of information into your mind, or to keep a piece of information in your memory.
exampleKurdish: ئەز تە ل بیر دکەم (تە دناسم).

definition: هاریکاریکردنا کەسەکی بۆ هندێ کو تشتەک بهێتە بیرا وی.
definitionEnglish: To make someone think of something they have forgotten or might have forgotten.
exampleKurdish: بێخە بیرا من کو تەلەفۆنێ بۆ بکەم.

definition: تشتەک کو هاریکارییا تە دکەت تشتەک بهێتە بیرا تە.
definitionEnglish: A written or spoken message that reminds someone to do something.

definition: جهەکێ دوور یان ئامێرەک بۆ کۆنترۆلکردنا تشتەکی ژ دوور ڤە.
definitionEnglish: Far away in distance or time, or a piece of equipment that you use for controlling something from a distance.

definition: کردارا لادانا تشتەکی ژ جهەکێ.
definitionEnglish: The act of taking something or someone away from somewhere.

definition: دوورخستنا تشتەکی یان کەسەکی ژ جهەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To take something or someone away from anywhere, or to take off a piece of clothing.

definition: سەردەمەکێ گەشەکرنا هونەر و زانستی د مێژوویێ دا یان بووژانەڤەیا تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: A new growth of activity or interest in something, especially art, literature, or music.

definition: گۆڕینا تشتەکی بۆ بارودۆخەکێ دی یان پێشکەشکردنا خزمەتگوزارییەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To cause someone or something to be in a particular state, or to give a service, a decision, etc.

definition: دەستپێکرنەڤەیا تشتەکی یان درێژکرنا ماوەیێ تشتەکی وەک پاسپۆرتێ.
definitionEnglish: To increase the life of or replace something old.

definition: کردارا نووکرنەڤەیا تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: The act of making something new again.

definition: کەسەک یان تشتەک کو گەلەک یێ بناوبانگ بیت ژبەر سیفەتەکێ باش.
definitionEnglish: Famous for something.

definition: دانا پارەی بۆ بکارئینانا خانی یان تشتەکی بۆ دەمەکێ.
definitionEnglish: A fixed amount of money that you pay regularly for the use of a room, house, car, television, etc. that belongs to someone else.

definition: تشتەکێ ب کرێ هاتیە گرتن یان پارەیێ کرێیێ.
definitionEnglish: An arrangement to rent something, or the amount of money that you pay to rent something.

definition: چێکرنا تشتەکێ شکەستی یان خراب بووی.
definitionEnglish: To fix something that is broken or damaged.

definition: ڤەگەراندنا پارەیێ تە قەرز کری.
definitionEnglish: To pay back money that you have borrowed.

definition: ئەنجامدانا تشتەکی یان گۆتنا تشتەکی بۆ جارا دووێ.
definitionEnglish: To say or tell something again, or to do something again.

definition: تشتەکێ کو گەلەک جاران رویدەت.
definitionEnglish: Happening again and again.

definition: ب شێوەیەکێ کو گەلەک جاران دووبارە دبیت.
definitionEnglish: Many times.

definition: دانانا تشتەکێ نوو ل جهێ تشتەکێ دی.
definitionEnglish: To take the place of something, or to put something or someone in the place of something or someone else.

definition: کەسەک یان تشتەک کو دهێتە دانان ل جهێ ئێکێ دی.
definitionEnglish: Someone or something that takes the place of another person or thing.

definition: بەرسڤدانا ئاخفتن یان نامەیەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To answer.

definition: وەسفەکا فەرمی دەربارەی رویدانەکێ یان بابەتەکی.
definitionEnglish: A description of an event or situation.

definition: کەسەکێ کارێ وی کۆمکرن و بەلاڤکردنا نووچەیانە.
definitionEnglish: A person whose job is to discover information about news events and describe them for a newspaper or magazine or for radio or television.

definition: کارێ ئامادەکردنا ڕاپۆرتان.
definitionEnglish: The activity of giving a report on something.

definition: ئاخفتن یان کارکردن ل سەر ناڤێ کەسەکێ دی یان وەلاتیەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To speak, act, or be present officially for another person or people.

definition: شێوازێ نیشاندانا تشتەکی یان هەبوونا نوێنەری.
definitionEnglish: The way that someone or something is shown or described, or the fact of having someone to speak or act for you.

definition: کەسەکێ هاتیە هەلبژاردن بۆ هندێ ل سەر ناڤێ گرووپەکێ باخڤیت.
definitionEnglish: Someone who speaks or does something officially for another person or group of people.

definition: دروستکردنا کۆپیەکێ ژ تشتەکی یان بەرهەمئینانا زارۆکان.
definitionEnglish: To produce a copy of something, or to produce young animals, plants, etc.

definition: کۆپیەکا تشتەکی یان پرۆسەیا زاوزێیێ.
definitionEnglish: The process of having babies, or a copy of something.

definition: وەلاتەک کو سەرۆکێ وی ژ لایێ خەلکی ڤە دهێتە هەلبژاردن.
definitionEnglish: A country that has an elected government and an elected leader.

definition: باوەرییا گشتی یا خەلکی دەربارەی کەسەکێ یان تشتەکێ.
definitionEnglish: The opinion that people in general have about someone or something, or how much respect or admiration someone or something receives, based on past behavior or character.

definition: داخوازییا تشتەکی ب شێوەیەکێ رێزدارانە.
definitionEnglish: The act of politely or officially asking for something.

definition: پێدڤی بوون ب تشتەکی یان داخوازکرنا تشتەکی ب فەرمی.
definitionEnglish: To need something or make something necessary.

definition: تشتەکێ کو پێدڤییە هەبیت یان بهێتە ئەنجامدان.
definitionEnglish: Something that you must do, or something you need.

definition: قورتالکردنا کەسەکی ژ بارودۆخەکێ مەترسیدار.
definitionEnglish: To help someone or something out of a dangerous, harmful, or unpleasant situation.

definition: ڤەکۆلینەکا هوور بۆ دیتنا راستیێن نوو دەربارەی بابەتەکی.
definitionEnglish: A detailed study of a subject, especially in order to discover (new) information or reach a (new) understanding.

definition: کەسەکێ کارێ وی ئەنجامدانا ڤەکۆلینانە.
definitionEnglish: Someone who studies a subject, especially in order to discover new information.

definition: گرتنا جهەکێ یان تشتەکێ بەری دەمێ بکارئینانێ.
definitionEnglish: An arrangement in which something such as a seat on an aircraft or a table at a restaurant is kept for you.

definition: هێلانا تشتەکی بۆ بکارئینانا پاشەرۆژێ یان گرتنا جهەکی.
definitionEnglish: To keep something for a particular purpose or time.

definition: تشتەکێ هاتیە گرتن بۆ کەسەکی یان کەسەکێ حەز نەکەت هەستێن خۆ دیار بکەت.
definitionEnglish: Kept for a particular person or group, or (of a person) tending to keep your feelings or thoughts to yourself.

definition: ئەو جهێ کەسەک لێ دژیت یان مافێ ژیانێ ل جهەکی.
definitionEnglish: A home, or the fact of living in a particular place.

definition: کەسەکێ ل جهەکێ دیاریکری دژیت.
definitionEnglish: A person who lives or has their home in a place.

definitionEnglish: The sport or activity of using boats with sails.

definitionEnglish: A fixed amount of money agreed every year as pay for an employee, usually paid directly into his or her bank account every month.

definition: ماددەیەکێ سپی یێ سروشتی کو بۆ تێهنکرنا خوارنێ دهێتە بکارئینان.

definition: تشتەکێ کو یێ باش بیت ب رادەیەکێ کو پێدڤییان پڕ بکەت.
definitionEnglish: Good or lucky enough for a particular need or purpose.

definition: پەیداکرنا تشتەکێ کو کەسەک پێدڤی پێ هەبیت یان دڤێت.
definitionEnglish: To please someone by giving them what they want or need.

definition: رۆژا شەشێ یا حەفتییێ.

definitionEnglish: Extremely violent, wild, or frightening.

definition: پاراستنا کەسەکی ژ مەترسییێ یان کۆمکرنا پارەی.
definitionEnglish: To stop someone or something from being killed, injured, or destroyed, or to keep money so that you can buy something with it in the future.

definition: ئەو پارێ کو تو کۆم دکەی و مەسرەف ناکەی.
definitionEnglish: The money you keep, especially in a bank or other financial organization.

definition: بکارئینانا پەیڤان بۆ دەربڕینا هزران یان پێزانینان.
definitionEnglish: To pronounce words or sounds, to express a thought, opinion, or suggestion, or to state a fact or instruction.

definitionEnglish: To look at something carefully, with the eyes or with a machine, in order to examine it.

definitionEnglish: A list of planned activities or things to be done showing the times or dates when they are intended to happen or be done.

definitionEnglish: A person who studies a subject in great detail, especially at a university.

definition: پارەیەک کو دهێتە دان ب قوتابیەکێ ژیر بۆ خواندنێ.

definitionEnglish: (knowledge from) the careful study of the structure and behavior of the physical world, especially by watching, measuring, and doing experiments, and the development of theories to describe the results of these activities.

definition: تشتەکێ کو خەلکێ دی نزانن و تو نەڤێت بزانیت.

definitionEnglish: To try to find or get something, especially something that is not a physical object.

definition: کەسەکێ کو پلەیەکا بلندا کارکرنێ هەبیت یان یێ ب تەمەن بیت.

definitionEnglish: An ability to understand, recognize, value, or react to something, especially any of the five physical abilities to see, hear, smell, taste, and feel.

definition: تێگەهشتنا هەستێن خەلکێ دی یان زوو کاریگەر بوون ب تشتان.

definition: ئارام و بێ دەنگ، بێی هیچ دڵەڕاوکێیەک.

definition: کۆمەکا تشتێن ژ هەمان جۆر کو ئێک ل دووڤ یێ دی دهێن.

definition: تشتەکێ کو پێدڤی ب هزرا هویر هەبیت یان بارودۆخەکێ خراب.

definition: پێشکێشکردنا خوارنێ یان کارکرن بۆ کەسەکێ یان وەلاتی.

definitionEnglish: A formal meeting or series of meetings of an organization such as a court or parliament, or a period of time or meeting devoted to a particular activity.

definition: رستەیەکا کورت و ب هێز کو د ریکلام یان سیاسەتێ دا دهێتە بکارئینان.
definitionEnglish: A short easily remembered phrase, especially one used to advertise an idea or a product.

definition: روویەک کو لایەکێ وی بلندتر بیت ژ لایێ دی.
definitionEnglish: A surface that lies at an angle to the horizontal so that some points on it are higher than others.

definition: کونەکا باریک بۆ دانانا تشتەکی یان دەمەکێ دیاریکری د خشتەیەکێ دا.
definitionEnglish: A long, narrow hole that is cut into something, or a particular time when something is planned to happen.
exampleEnglish: Put a coin in the slot.

definition: جوولان یان ئەنجامدانا تشتەکی ب خێراییەکا کێم.
definitionEnglish: Moving, happening, or doing something without much speed.

definition: ب شێوەیەکێ هێواش.
definitionEnglish: In a slow way.

definition: نەبوونا قەبارە یان چەنداتیەکا مەزن.
definitionEnglish: Little in size or amount when compared with what is typical or average.

definition: کەسەکێ خودان مێشکەکێ تیژ یان جلوبەرگێن جوان و رێک و پێک.
definitionEnglish: Intelligent, or having a clean, tidy, and stylish appearance.

definition: شکاندنا تشتەکی ب هێز بۆ پارچەیێن بچویک.
definitionEnglish: To cause something to break noisily into a lot of small pieces.

definition: توانایا هەستکردن ب بێهنێ ب رێکا لووتی.
definitionEnglish: The characteristic of something that can be recognized by using the nose.

definition: شێوەیەکێ دەم و چاوی کو نیشانا کەیفخۆشییێ یە.
definitionEnglish: A happy or friendly expression on the face in which the ends of the mouth curve up slightly.

definition: ئەو گازا رەنگ خۆلی یا کو ژ ئاگری دەردکەڤیت.
definitionEnglish: The grey, black, or white mixture of gas and very small pieces of carbon that is produced when something burns.

definition: روویەکێ تەخت و بێ گرێ یان بارودۆخەکێ بێ ئاریشە.
definitionEnglish: Having a surface or consisting of a substance that is perfectly regular and has no holes, lumps, or areas that rise or fall suddenly.

definition: ب شێوەیەکێ ئاسان و بێ ئاریشە.
definitionEnglish: Easily and without any problems.
exampleKurdish: هەمی تشت ب بێ کێشە برێڤە چوو.

definition: بڕەکێ کێم یێ خوارنێ کو د ناڤبەرا ژەمێن سەرەکی دا دهێتە خوارن.
definitionEnglish: A small amount of food that is eaten between meals, or a very small meal.

definition: ئاژەلەکێ درێژ و باریک یێ بێ پێ کو ل سەر عەردی دخلیسکیت.
definitionEnglish: A reptile with a long, thin body and no legs.

definition: شکاندنا تشتەکی ب دەنگەکێ بلند یان وێنەگرتنەکا خێرا.
definitionEnglish: To cause something to make a short, loud noise, or to take a photograph.

definition: چوون بۆ جهەکی ب بێدەنگی بۆ وێ چەندێ کەس تە نەبینیت.
definitionEnglish: To go somewhere secretly, or to take someone or something somewhere secretly.
exampleKurdish: ب دزی ڤە ژ مال دەرکەفتن.

definition: دەرخستنا هەوای ب هێز و ب دەنگ ژ لووتی ژبەر بێزاربوونا لووتی.
definitionEnglish: When you sneeze, air and often small drops of liquid suddenly come out of your nose and mouth in a way you cannot control.

definition: بێهنکرنا تشتەکی ب کێشانا هەوای ب لووتی.
definitionEnglish: To smell something by taking air in through your nose.

definition: ئاڤا بەستی یا سپی کو ژ عەسمانی دکەڤیتە خوارێ.
definitionEnglish: The small, soft, white pieces of ice that sometimes fall from the sky when it is cold, or the white layer on the ground and other surfaces that it forms.

definition: ب رادەیەکێ مەزن یان بۆ نیشاندانا ئەنجامێ کارەکی.
definitionEnglish: To a great degree, or used to introduce the result of something.

definition: دانانا تشتەکی د ناڤ ئاڤێ دا بۆ دەمەکێ درێژ.
definitionEnglish: To leave something in liquid, especially water, for a period of time.
exampleKurdish: فاسۆلیان تەڕ بکە (بکە د ناڤ ئاڤێ دا).

definition: ماددەیەک کو دگەل ئاڤێ دهێتە بکارئینان بۆ شۆشتنا جەستەی یان تشتان.
definitionEnglish: A substance used with water for washing and cleaning.

definition: بەرزبوونەڤە ب خێراییەکا زۆر یان فڕین ل عەسمانی بلند.
definitionEnglish: To rise very quickly to a high level, or to fly high in the air.

definition: گریان ب دەنگەکێ بلند و ب هەناسە سواری.
definitionEnglish: To cry noisily, taking in deep, short breaths.
exampleKurdish: ئەو دەستی ب گریانا ب کوڵ کر.

definition: یارییەکا تۆپێ کو ب پێیان دهێتە ئەنجامدان.
definitionEnglish: A game played between two teams of eleven people, where each team tries to win by kicking a ball into the other team's goal.

definition: تشتەکێ گرێدای ب جڤاکی و پەیوەندییێن خەلکی ڤە.
definitionEnglish: Relating to society and to people's lives in general.

definition: سیستەمەکێ سیاسی و ئابووری کو تێدا دەولەت یان جڤاک کۆنترۆلا داهاتی دکەت.
definitionEnglish: The set of beliefs that states that all people are equal and should share equally in a country's money, or the political system based on these beliefs.

definition: کەسەکێ باوەری ب سۆشیالیزمێ هەبیت.
definitionEnglish: A person who believes in or belongs to a party that believes in socialism.

definition: کۆمەکا خەلکی کو پێکڤە دژین د ناڤ سیستەمەکێ رێکخستی دا.
definitionEnglish: A large group of people who live together in an organized way, making decisions about how to do things and sharing the work that needs to be done.

definition: جلوبەرگەک بۆ داپۆشینا پێیان کو د ناڤ پێلاڤێ دا دهێتە لەبەرکرن.
definitionEnglish: A piece of clothing made from soft material that covers your foot and the lower part of your leg.

definition: ئەو کونا کارەبێ یا ل سەر دیواری کو فیشێ تێدا دهێتە دانان.
definitionEnglish: The part of a piece of electrical equipment into which another part fits, or the part of a wall where you can connect electrical equipment to the electricity supply.

definition: خوارنەوەیەکا شیرین و گازدار.
definitionEnglish: A sweet, carbonated drink.

definition: کورسیەکا درێژ و نەرم بۆ روینشتنا دوو کەسان یان زێدەتر.
definitionEnglish: A long, soft seat with a back and arms, on which more than one person can sit at the same time.

definition: تشتەکێ کو ب ئاسانی دهێتە چەماندن یان دەنگەکێ هێواش.
definitionEnglish: Not hard or firm.

definition: ب شێوەیەکێ نەرم یان ب دەنگەکێ نزم.
definitionEnglish: In a quiet or gentle way.

definition: بەرنامەیێن کۆمپیوتەری کو کاران ئەنجام ددەن.
definitionEnglish: The instructions that control what a computer does; computer programs.

definition: تەبەقەیا سەرەکی یا عەردی کو رووەک تێدا شین دبن.
definitionEnglish: The material on the surface of the ground in which plants grow.

definition: تشتەکێ گرێدای ب رۆژێ ڤە.
definitionEnglish: Of or from the sun, or using the energy from the sun.

definition: کەسەکێ ئەندام بیت د سوپای دا.
definitionEnglish: A person who is in an army and wears its uniform, especially someone who fights when there is a war.

definition: تەنێ ئێک یان بنی پێلاڤێ.
definitionEnglish: Being the only one, or the bottom part of a foot or shoe.

definition: ب تنێ و بێی هیچ کەسەکێ یان تشتەکێ دی.
definitionEnglish: Only and not involving anyone or anything else.

definition: تشتەکێ رەق کو نە شل بیت و نە گاز بیت.
definitionEnglish: Hard or firm, with a fixed shape, and not a liquid or gas.

definition: کەسەک یان تشتەکێ کو ب تنێ بیت و حەز ب تەنێ بوونێ بکەت.
definitionEnglish: A solitary person or thing is the only one of its type in a particular place, or spending a lot of time alone.

definition: ئەنجامدانا کارەکی ب تنێ بێی هاریکارییا کەسێ.
definitionEnglish: Done by one person alone, without any help.

definition: بەرسڤا کێشەیەکێ یان تێکەلەیەکا شل.
definitionEnglish: The answer to a problem, or a liquid into which a solid has been mixed and has dissolved.

definition: دۆزینەڤەیا رێکا دروست بۆ دوماهیک ئینان ب کێشەیەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To find an answer to a problem.

definition: بڕەک یان هژمارەکا تشتان کو نەهاتیە دیاریکردن.
definitionEnglish: An amount or number of something that is not stated or is not known.

definition: کەسەکێ نەدیار.
definitionEnglish: Someone.

meaning: ب شێوەیەک / بە هەر جۆرێک بێت
definition: ب رێگایەکێ کو تو نزانی چەوانە بەلێ دێ رویدەت.
definitionEnglish: In a way or by some means that is not known or not stated.

definition: کەسەکێ نەدیار.
definitionEnglish: Somebody.

definition: تشتەکێ نەدیار.
definitionEnglish: An object, event, or situation that is not known or stated.

definition: دەمەکێ نەدیار د رابردوو یان پاشەرۆژێ دا.

definition: د هندەک دەمان دا بەلێ نە هەمی جاران.
definitionEnglish: On some occasions but not always or often.

definition: ب رادەیەکێ کێم.

definition: جهەکێ نەدیار.
definitionEnglish: In or to a place or position that is not known or stated.

definition: زارۆکێ نێر یێ دایک و بابەکی.
definitionEnglish: A person's male child.

definition: پارچەیەکا مۆزیکێ کو پەیڤێن تێدا دهێنە گۆتن.
definitionEnglish: A short piece of music with words that are sung.

definition: پشتی دەمەکێ کێم ژ نوکە.
definitionEnglish: In or after a short time.

definition: ئارامکرنا کەسەکێ تورە یان کێمکرنا ئازارەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To make someone feel calm or less worried, or to make a part of the body less painful.

definition: تشتەکێ کو ب شێوەیەکێ ئالۆز و پێشکەفتی هاتیە دروستکرن یان کەسەکێ خودان ئەزموونەکا زۆر.
definitionEnglish: Having a good understanding of the way people behave and/or a good knowledge of culture and fashion, or (of a machine, system, or technique) developed to a high degree of complexity.

definition: پشکەکا جەستەی کو ئازار هەبیت ژبەر برین یان وەستیانێ.
definitionEnglish: Painful and uncomfortable because of injury, infection, or too much use.

definition: هەستکردن ب خەمگینییێ یان داخبار بوون ژبەر کارەکێ تە کری.

definition: جۆرەکێ تشتان یان رێکخستنا تشتان ب رێز.

definition: ئەو پشکەکا مروڤی یا کو نە جەستەیی یە و باوەری وەسا هەیە کو پشتی مرنێ دمینیت.
definitionEnglish: The spiritual part of a person that some people believe continues to exist in some form after their body has died, or the part of a person that is not physical and experiences deep feelings and emotions.

definition: ئەو تشتێ تو ب گوهێن خۆ دبیسی یان تشتەکێ کو یێ دروست و ساخلەم بیت.
definitionEnglish: Something that you hear or can be heard, or in good condition; not damaged, injured, or diseased.

definition: خوارنەکا شل کو ژ سەوزە یان گۆشتی دهێتە دروستکرن.
definitionEnglish: A usually hot, liquid food made from vegetables, meat, or fish.

definition: تامەک وەک تاما لیمۆنێ.
definitionEnglish: Having a sharp, sometimes unpleasant, taste or smell, like a lemon, and not sweet.

definition: ئەو جهێ تشتەک ژێ دەستپێدکەت یان دهێت.
definitionEnglish: The place something comes from or starts at, or the cause of something.

definition: ئاراستەیا بەرامبەر باکووری.
definitionEnglish: The direction that is on your right when you face the rising sun.

definition: تشتەکێ گرێدای ب باشووری ڤە.
definitionEnglish: In or from the south part of an area.

definition: تشتەکێ تو دکڕی بۆ ب بیرهاتنا گەشتەکێ یان جهەکی.
definitionEnglish: Something you buy or keep to help you remember a holiday or special event.

definition: وەلاتەکێ سەربەخۆ یان کەسەکێ دەستهەلاتا بلند هەبیت.
definitionEnglish: A king or queen, or (of a country) independent and having the power to govern itself.

definition: تشتەکێ گرێدای ب ئێکەتیا سۆڤیەتا جاران ڤە.
definitionEnglish: Relating to the former Soviet Union.

definition: رۆبەرەکێ ڤالا یان ئەو بۆشایییا ل دەرڤەی زەڤیێ.
definitionEnglish: An empty area that is available to be used, or the area outside the earth's atmosphere where the planets and stars are.

definition: جهەک کو رۆبەرەکێ مەزن و ڤالا هەبیت.
definitionEnglish: Large and with a lot of space.

definition: وەلاتەک ل باشوورێ رۆژئاڤایێ ئەوروپا.
definitionEnglish: A country in southwestern Europe.

definition: تشتەکێ گرێدای ب ئیسپانیا یان زمانێ وان ڤە.
definitionEnglish: Relating to Spain, its people, or its language.

definition: تشتەکێ زێدە کو تو نوکە بکار نائینی یان دانا دەمی بۆ کەسەکی.
definitionEnglish: If something is spare, it is available to use because it is extra, or to give time, money, or space to someone.

definition: پارچەیەکا بچویک یا ئاگری یان تشتەکێ دبیتە ئەگەرێ دەستپێکرنا رویدانەکێ.
definitionEnglish: A very small piece of burning material produced by a fire or by hitting or rubbing two hard objects together, or to cause the start of something.

definition: بکارئینانا دەنگی بۆ گۆتنا پەیڤان.
definitionEnglish: To say words, to use the voice, or to have a conversation with someone.

definition: کەسەکێ دئاخڤیت یان ئامێرەک بۆ بلندکرنا دەنگی.
definitionEnglish: A person who gives a speech at a public meeting, or the part of a radio, television, or computer, or a piece of electrical equipment for playing recorded sound, through which the sound is played.
