definition: تشتەکێ کو جودا بیت ژ یێن دی و گرنگیەکا زێدە هەبیت.
definitionEnglish: Not ordinary or usual, but different in some way and often better or more important.

definition: کەسەکێ کو زانینەکا زۆر و تایبەت هەبیت د بوارەکێ دا.
definitionEnglish: Someone who has a lot of experience, knowledge, or skill in a particular subject.

definition: تشتەکێ کو بۆ مەبەستەکا تایبەت هاتیە دروستکرن.
definitionEnglish: Working in or involving only one particular area of a subject, or designed for a particular purpose.

definition: کۆمەکا ئاژەل یان رووەکان کو سیفەتێن هاوبەش هەبن.
definitionEnglish: A set of animals or plants in which the members have similar characteristics to each other and can breed with each other.

definition: تشتەکێ روون و دیاریکری.
definitionEnglish: Particular and exact.

definition: ب شێوەیەکێ تایبەت بۆ مەبەستەکێ.
definitionEnglish: For a particular reason, purpose, etc.
exampleKurdish: ب تایبەتی بۆ زارۆکان هاتیە دروستکرن.

definition: گۆتنا تشتەکی ب روونی و ب هوێری.
definitionEnglish: To explain or describe something clearly and exactly.

definition: تشتەکێ دهێتە بکارئینان وەک نموونە بۆ لێکۆلینێ.
definitionEnglish: Something shown or examined as an example; a typical example.

definition: رویدانەک یان دیمەنەکێ سەرسوڕهێنەر کو سەرنجا خەلکی رادکێشیت.
definitionEnglish: An unusual or unexpected event or situation that attracts an attention, interest, or disapproval.

definition: تشتەکێ گەلەک جوان و سەرنجڕاکێش.
definitionEnglish: Very exciting to look at which is especially great.

definition: کەسەکێ تەماشای رویدانەکێ دکەت (وەک یارییەکا وەرزشی).
definitionEnglish: A person who watches an activity, especially a sports event, without taking part.

definition: مەودایەکا بەرفراوان ژ رەنگان یان بیروڕایان.
definitionEnglish: A range of different positions, opinions, etc. between two extreme points.

definition: هزرکردن دەربارەی ئەگەرێن تشتەکی بێی کو هەمی راستییان بزانی.
definitionEnglish: To guess possible answers to a question when you do not have enough information to be certain.

definition: ئاخفتنەکا فەرمی کو بۆ کۆمەکا خەلکی دهێتە گۆتن.
definitionEnglish: The ability to talk, the activity of talking, or a formal talk given to a group of people.

definition: چەنداتییا خێرایییا جوولانا تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: How fast something or someone moves or happens.

definition: گۆتن یان نڤیسینا پیتێن پەیڤەکێ ب رێزبەندی یان دەمەکێ کورت.
definitionEnglish: To form a word by writing or naming the letters in the correct order, or a short period of a particular type of weather or activity.
exampleKurdish: تو چەوان سپێڵ دکەی (پیتێن وێ دبیژی)؟

definition: شێوازێ نڤیسینا پیتێن پەیڤەکێ ب دروستی.
definitionEnglish: The correct way of writing a word.

definition: دانا پارەی بۆ کڕینا تشتان یان بکارئینانا دەمی بۆ کارەکی.
definitionEnglish: To use money to buy or pay for something, or to use time doing something or being somewhere.

definition: تشتەکێ خڕ وەک تۆپێ یان بوارەکێ دیاریکری یێ چالاکییێ.
definitionEnglish: An object shaped like a round ball, or a particular area of activity, work, knowledge, etc.

definition: ماددەیەکێ رووەکی کو تاما خوارنێ پێ خۆش دکەن.
definitionEnglish: A substance made from a plant, used to give a special flavour to food.

definition: خوارنەکا کو تاما بەهاراتێن توند تێدا بیت.
definitionEnglish: Containing strong flavours from spices.

definition: گیانەوەرەکێ بچویک یێ هەشت پێ کو تەڤنێ چێدکەت.
definitionEnglish: A small creature with eight legs that catches insects in a web.

definition: رژانا شلەیەکێ ژ قاپەکێ ب خەلەتی.
definitionEnglish: To (cause to) flow, move, fall, or spread over the edge or outside the limits of something.

definition: زڤڕین ب دەوری خاڵەکێ دا ب خێرایی.
definitionEnglish: To (cause to) turn around and around, especially fast.

definition: ئەو هەستیێن ل پشتێ کو جەستەی رادگرن.
definitionEnglish: The line of bones down the centre of the back that provides support for the body.

definition: ئەو پشکەکا مروڤی یا کو نە جەستەیی یە یان هەستێ ئازایەتییێ.
definitionEnglish: The way you feel, think, and behave, or the spiritual part of a person.

definition: تشتەکێ گرێدای ب ڕۆح و ئایین ڤە نەک جەستە.
definitionEnglish: Relating to deep feelings and beliefs, especially religious beliefs, rather than the physical world.

definition: دەرخستنا ئاڤا دەڤی ب هێز.
definitionEnglish: To force out the liquid from your mouth.

definition: هەستەکێ خراب بەرامبەر کەسەکی یان ئەنجامدانا کارەکی سەرەڕای ئاستەنگان.
definitionEnglish: A feeling of wanting to hurt or upset someone, or used before a fact that makes something seem surprising.

definition: کەفتنا ئاڤێ ب سەر تشتەکی دا ب دەنگەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To move in water so that it goes everywhere, or to cause a liquid to fly about in drops.

definition: تشتەکێ گەلەک جوان و نایاب.
definitionEnglish: Excellent, or extremely beautiful and impressive.

definition: دابەشکرنا تشتەکی بۆ دوو پشک یان زێدەتر.
definitionEnglish: To divide into two or more parts, especially along a particular line.

definition: خرابکرنا تشتەکی یان تێکچوونا خوارنێ.
definitionEnglish: To destroy or reduce the pleasure, interest, or beauty of something, or (of food) to become bad and not fit to eat.

definition: کەسەکێ کو ب ناڤێ کەسەکێ دی یان رێکخراوەکێ دئاخڤیت.
definitionEnglish: A man who is chosen to speak officially for a group or organization.

definition: کەسەک یان کۆمپانیەک کو پارەی ددەت بۆ پشتگیریکرنا رویدانەکێ یان کەسەکی.
definitionEnglish: A person or organization that pays for or plans and carries out a project or activity.

definition: کارەکێ کو بێی پلان و ب شێوەیەکێ سروشتی رویدەت.
definitionEnglish: Happening or done in a natural, often sudden way, without any planning or without being forced.

definition: ئامێرەکێ خوارنێ کو پشکەکا خڕ و دەسکەکێ درێژ هەبیت.
definitionEnglish: An object with a handle and a round, curved part at one end, used for eating and serving food.

definition: چالاکیەکا جەستەیی کو ب رێسایێن دیاریکری دهێتە ئەنجامدان.
definitionEnglish: A game, competition, or activity needing physical effort and skill that is played according to rules, for enjoyment and/or as a job.

definition: جهەکێ بچویک یان نیشانەک ل سەر تشتەکی یان دیتنا تشتەکی ب زەحمەت.
definitionEnglish: A small, usually round, area of colour that is differently coloured or shaped from the area around it, or a particular place, or to see or notice someone or something.

definition: هەڤژین (مێر یان ژن).
definitionEnglish: A person's husband or wife.

definition: بەلاڤبوونا تشتەکی ل سەر رۆبەرەکێ مەزن.
definitionEnglish: To (cause to) cover, reach, or have an effect on a wider area or more people.

definition: وەرزێ پشتی زستانی یان سەرچاوەیا ئاڤێ یان قەفازەک.
definitionEnglish: The season of the year between winter and summer, or a place where water comes out of the ground, or to move quickly and suddenly towards a particular place.

definition: کەسەکێ ب دزی ڤە زانیارییان کۆم دکەت.
definitionEnglish: A person who secretly collects and reports information about the activities of another country or organization.

definition: شێوەیەکێ چوار لایێن یەکسان هەبن یان جهەکێ ڤالا د ناڤ باژێری دا.
definitionEnglish: A flat shape with four equal sides and four angles of 90°, or an area of approximately square-shaped land in a city or a town, often including the buildings that surround it.

definition: گوشینا تشتەکی ب هێز بۆ دەرخستنا شلەیەکێ یان کێمکرنا جهی.
definitionEnglish: To press something firmly, especially from all sides in order to change its shape, reduce its size, or remove liquid from it.

definition: بریندارکرنا کەسەکی ب ئامێرەکێ تیژ وەک چەقۆیێ.
definitionEnglish: To injure someone with a sharp-pointed object such as a knife.

definition: بارودۆخەکێ کو تێدا تشت نەهێنە گوهۆڕین و جێگیر بن.
definitionEnglish: A situation in which something is not likely to move or change.

definition: تشتەکێ کو ب ئاسانی نەهێتە گوهۆڕین یان جهێ هسپان.
definitionEnglish: Firmly fixed or not likely to move or change, or a building in which horses are kept.

definition: کۆمەکا تشتان کو ل سەر ئێک هاتبنە دانان.
definitionEnglish: A pile of things arranged one on top of another.

definition: جهەکێ مەزن بۆ ئەنجامدانا یارییان و روینشتنا تەماشاکەران.
definitionEnglish: A large closed area of land used for playing sports, which is surrounded by rows of seats for spectators.

definition: کۆمەکا خەلکی کو ل جهەکی کار دکەن.
definitionEnglish: The group of people who work for an organization.

definition: پشکەک ژ پێڤاژۆیەکێ یان ئەو جهێ بلند یێ شانۆگەری ل سەر دهێتە ئەنجامدان.
definitionEnglish: A part of an activity or a period of development, or the area in a theatre which is often raised and on which actors or entertainers perform.

definition: رێڤەچوون ب شێوەیەکێ نەجێگیر یان سەرسامکرنا کەسەکی ب رادەیەکێ مەزن.
definitionEnglish: To walk or move with difficulty as if you are going to fall, or to cause someone to feel extremely surprised or shocked.
exampleKurdish: ئەو ب تەلەزە ڤە چوو بۆ مال.

definition: نیشانەکا پیس کو ب ئاسانی ژ ناڤ ناچیت.
definitionEnglish: A dirty mark on something that is difficult to remove.

definition: ئەو پلەیێن کو تو پێ بلند دبی بۆ تەبەقەیەکا دی.
definitionEnglish: A set of steps that lead from one level of a building to another.

definition: پشکەک ژ کارەکی یان تشتەکێ کو تو د مەترسییێ دا ددەی.
definitionEnglish: A share or a financial involvement in something such as a business, or the amount of money that you risk on the result of something such as a game or race.

definition: خوارنەکا (وەک نانی) کو نە یا نوو بیت و رەق بووبیت.
definitionEnglish: No longer new or fresh, usually as a result of being kept for too long.

definition: مێزەکا بچویک بۆ فرۆشتنا تشتان یان وەستاندنا بێ پلان یا ماتۆرەکی.
definitionEnglish: A large table or a small shop with an open front from which goods are sold in a public place, or to stop making progress or to delay an event or action.

definition: پارچەیەکا بچویک یا کاغەزێ بۆ نامەیان یان مۆرکردن.
definitionEnglish: A small piece of paper with a picture or design on it that you stick onto an envelope before you post it, or a tool for printing a mark or design on a surface.
exampleEnglish: Put a stamp on the letter.

definition: بیروڕایەکا دیاریکری دەربارەی بابەتەکی یان شێوازێ وەستانا جەستەی.
definitionEnglish: A particular way of standing, or a way of thinking about something, especially expressed in a publicly stated opinion.

definition: مان ل سەر پێیان یان قەبوولکرنا بارودۆخەکێ نەخۆش.
definitionEnglish: To be in a vertical state on your feet, or to successfully accept or bear something that is unpleasant or difficult.

definition: ئاستەکێ دیاریکری یێ جۆری کو دهێتە قەبوولکردن.
definitionEnglish: A level of quality.

definition: دروستکرنا تشتان ب شێوەیەکێ کو هەمی وەک ئێک بن.
definitionEnglish: To make things of the same type all have the same features or parts.

definition: مان ل سەر پێیان یان پێگەیەکێ جڤاکی.
definitionEnglish: The position or reputation of someone or something within a group or organization, or in a vertical position.

definition: ئەو تشتێن گەش ل عەسمانی یان کەسەکێ ناودار.
definitionEnglish: A very large ball of burning gas in space that is usually seen from the earth as a bright point in the sky at night, or a very famous, successful, and important person.

definition: تەماشاکردنەکا درێژ و ب سەرنج بۆ کەسەکێ یان تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: To look for a long time with the eyes wide open, especially when surprised, frightened, or thinking.

definition: دەستپێکرنا ئەنجامدانا کارەکی.
definitionEnglish: To begin doing something.

definition: کەسەکێ دەستپێدکەت یان خوارنەکا سووک پێش خوارنا سەرەکی.
definitionEnglish: A person or thing that starts something, or a small amount of food that is served before the main course of a meal.

definition: مانەوە بێ خوارن بۆ دەمەکێ درێژ کو ببیتە ئەگەرێ مرنێ یان لاوازبوونا زۆر.
definitionEnglish: To (cause to) die of hunger.
exampleKurdish: ب ملیۆنان خەلک یێ ژ برسان دمرن.

definition: وەلاتەک یان پشکەک ژ وەلاتەکی یان بارودۆخەکێ دیاریکری یان گۆتنا تشتەکی ب فەرمی.
definitionEnglish: A country or its government, or a condition or way of being that exists at a particular time, or to say or write something, especially clearly and carefully.

definition: تشتەکێ کو تو دبێژی یان دنڤیسی بۆ دانا زانیارییان ب فەرمی.
definitionEnglish: Something that someone says or writes officially, or an action done to express an opinion.

definition: سیاسەتمەدارەکێ شارەزا و رێزگرتی.
definitionEnglish: An experienced politician, especially one who is respected for making good judgments.

definition: تشتەکێ کو نەجوولیت و نەهێتە گوهۆڕین.
definitionEnglish: Staying in one place or at one level, or not changing.

definition: جهەک کو پاس یان شەمەندەفەر لێ دوەستن یان بنکەیەکا کارەکی.
definitionEnglish: A building and the surrounding area where buses or trains stop for people to get on or off, or a place where a particular service or type of work is done.

definition: زانیارییەکا هژماری دەربارەی تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: A fact in the form of a number that shows information about something.

definition: تشتەکێ گرێدای ب ئامار و هژماران ڤە.
definitionEnglish: Relating to statistics.

definition: کارەکێ هونەری یێ دروستکری ژ بەرد یان ئاسنی کو شێوەیێ مروڤ یان ئاژەلی هەبیت.
definitionEnglish: An object made from a hard material, especially stone or metal, to look like a person or animal.

definition: پێگەیێ جڤاکی یێ کەسەکی یان بارودۆخێ نوکە یێ تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: The position or rank of someone or something when compared to others in a society, organization, or group, or the state or condition of something at a particular time.

definition: یاسایەکا نڤیسین یا کو ژ لایێ حکومەتێ ڤە هاتیە دانان.
definitionEnglish: A law that has been formally approved and written down.

definition: مان ل جهەکی بۆ دەمەکێ و نەچوونە جهەکێ دی.
definitionEnglish: To continue to be in a place or condition.

definition: تشتەکێ کو ب شێوەیەکێ رێک و پێک و جێگیر رویدەت یان دجوولیت.
definitionEnglish: Happening in a smooth, gradual, and regular way, not suddenly or unexpectedly.

definition: پارچەیەکا مەزن و تەخت یا گۆشتی.
definitionEnglish: A thick, flat piece of meat or fish, especially meat from a cow.

definition: برنا تشتێ کەسەکێ دی ب بێ دەستووری.
definitionEnglish: To take something without the permission or knowledge of its owner and keep it.

definition: ئەو هەلما ژ ئاڤا کەلاندی دەردکەڤیت.
definitionEnglish: The hot gas that is produced when water boils.

definition: ئاسنەکێ ب هێز و رەق یێ تێکەلکری.
definitionEnglish: A strong metal that is a mixture of iron and carbon, used for making things that need a strong structure, especially vehicles and buildings.

definition: لێژیەکا زۆر کو سەرکەفتن ل سەر یا ب زەحمەت بیت یان نرخەکێ زۆر بلند.
definitionEnglish: (of a slope) rising or falling at a sharp angle, or (of a price) very high.

definition: کۆنترۆلکرنا ئاراستەیا ترومبێلەکێ یان پاپۆرەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To control the direction of a vehicle.

definition: پشکا سەرەکی یا رووەکی کو گەل و گولان هەلدگریت یان دەستپێکرنا تشتەکی ژ تشتەکێ دی.
definitionEnglish: The stick-like central part of a plant that grows above the ground and from which leaves and flowers grow, or to start or develop as the result of something.

definition: جوولانا پێیەکێ بۆ پێشڤە یان پشکەک ژ پێڤاژۆیەکێ.
definitionEnglish: The action of lifting one foot and putting it down in a different place, or one of a series of actions that you take in order to achieve something.

definition: بیروڕایەکا سادە و گشتی دەربارەی کۆمەکا خەلکی کو زۆربەیا جاران نە یا دروستە.
definitionEnglish: A set idea that people have about what someone or something is like, especially an idea that is wrong.

definition: پارچەیەکا درێژ و باریک یا داری یان لکاندنا تشتەکی ب تشتەکێ دی ڤە.
definitionEnglish: A thin piece of wood that has fallen or been cut from a tree, or to cause something to become fixed, for example with glue or another similar substance.

definition: تشتەکێ کو ب ئاسانی بلکیتە تشتەکێ دی ڤە.
definitionEnglish: Made of or covered with a substance that stays attached to any surface it touches.

definition: تشتەکێ کو ب ئاسانی نەهێتە چەماندن یان جوولاندن.
definitionEnglish: Firm or hard and not bending or moving easily.

definition: بەردەوام بوونا بارودۆخەکێ هەتا نوکە یان تشتەکێ بێ دەنگ و بێ جوولە.
definitionEnglish: Continuing to happen or continuing to be done, or staying in the same position; not moving.

definition: هاندانا تشتەکی بۆ وێ چەندێ گەشە بکەت یان چالاکتر بیت.
definitionEnglish: To encourage something to grow, develop, or become active.

definition: تشتەکێ دبیتە ئەگەرێ چالاکبوونا تشتەکێ دی.
definitionEnglish: Something that causes growth or activity.

definition: بریندارکرنا پێستی ب رێکا مێشەکێ یان رووەکەکێ کو ببیتە ئەگەرێ ئازارەکا تیژ.
definitionEnglish: If an insect, plant, or animal stings, it produces a small but sharp pain, often with a little poison, by piercing your skin.

definition: تێکدانا شلەیەکێ ب کەچکەکێ یان جوولانەکا کێم.
definitionEnglish: To mix a liquid or other substance by moving an object such as a spoon in a circular pattern.

definition: بڕێ تشتێن بەرهەڤکری بۆ فرۆشتنێ یان پشکەک ژ کۆمپانیەکێ.
definitionEnglish: A supply of something that is available for use, or part of the ownership of a company that can be bought and sold.

definition: ئەو پشکا جەستەی یا کو خوارن تێدا دهێتە هەرسکرن.
definitionEnglish: The organ in your body where food goes after you have eaten it and where it starts to be digested.

definition: ماددەیەکێ رەق یێ سروشتی یێ عەردی.
definitionEnglish: The hard, solid substance found in the ground that is used for building.

definition: دوماهیک ئینان ب جوولان یان کارەکی.
definitionEnglish: To finish doing something that you were doing.

definition: پاراستنا تشتان ل جهەکێ بۆ بکارئینانا پاشەرۆژێ.
definitionEnglish: The putting and keeping of things in a special place for use in the future.

definition: جهەک بۆ فرۆشتنا تشتان یان هەلگرتنا تشتان.
definitionEnglish: A large shop where you can buy many different types of goods, or to keep anything in a place for future use.

definition: کەشوهەوایەکێ خراب یێ خودان بایەکێ ب هێز و بارانەکا زۆر.
definitionEnglish: An extreme weather condition with very strong wind, heavy rain, and often thunder and lightning.

definition: گێڕانەڤەیا رویدانان یان تەبەقەیەکا خانی.
definitionEnglish: A description, either true or imagined, of a connected series of events, or a level of a building.

definition: کەسەکێ قەلەو و ب هێز یان تشتەکێ پتەو.
definitionEnglish: (of a person) fat and solid-looking, or strong and thick.

definition: تشتەکێ کو نە چەمی بیت و ب رێکا کورت بچیت.
definitionEnglish: Continuing in one direction without bending or curving.

definition: تشتەکێ کو ب ساناهی بیت بۆ تێگەهشتن یان ئەنجامدانێ.
definitionEnglish: Easy to understand or simple.

definition: فشارەکا زۆر ل سەر جەستەی یان مێشکی یان جوداکرنا شلەیەکێ ژ تشتێن رەق.
definitionEnglish: A force or influence that stretches, pulls, or puts pressure on something, sometimes causing damage, or to separate liquid from much more solid food.

definition: تشتەکێ نە ئاسایی و جودا کو مروڤ پێ سەرسام دبیت.
definitionEnglish: Unusual and unexpected, or difficult to understand.

definition: کەسەکێ تو نەناسی.
definitionEnglish: Someone you do not know.

definition: تشتەکێ کو ب پلانەکا هویر و بۆ دەمەکێ درێژ هاتیە ئەنجامدان.
definitionEnglish: Helping to achieve a plan, for example in business or politics.

definition: پلانەکا درێژخایەن بۆ گەهشتن ب ئارمانجەکێ.
definitionEnglish: A detailed plan for achieving success in situations such as war, politics, business, industry, or sport.

definition: قامیشەکێ باریک بۆ ڤەخوارنا شلەمەنییان یان کایا وشک.
definitionEnglish: The dried, yellow stems of crops such as wheat, used as food for animals or as a layer on the ground for them to lie on, or a thin tube made of plastic or waterproof paper that is used to suck liquid into the mouth.

definition: میوەیەکا بچویک و سۆر و شیرین.
definitionEnglish: A small juicy red fruit that has small brown seeds on its surface, or the plant that produces this fruit.

definition: هێلەکا درێژ یا رەنگەکێ جودا یان ماوەیەکا بەردەوام یا سەرکەفتن یان شکەستنێ.
definitionEnglish: A long, thin mark that is a different colour from its surroundings, or a short period of good or bad luck.

definition: ئاڤەکا رەوان یا بچویک یان لێشاوەکا بەردەوام یا تشتان.
definitionEnglish: A continuous flow of things or people, or a small river.

definition: رێگایەکا گشتی د ناڤ باژێری دا کو خانی ل هەردوو لایێن وێ هەبن.
definitionEnglish: A public road in a city or town that has houses and buildings on one or both sides.

definition: سیفەتێ ب هێز بوونێ یان توانایا جەستەیی و مێشکی.
definitionEnglish: The ability to do things that need a lot of physical or mental effort.

definition: پتر لێکرنا هێزا تشتەکی یان کەسەکی.
definitionEnglish: To make something or someone stronger.

definition: هەستکردن ب دڵەڕاوکێیەکا زۆر یان جەختکردن ل سەر پەیڤەکێ یان بابەتەکی.
definitionEnglish: Great worry caused by a difficult situation, or the way that a word or part of a word is pronounced with greater force than other words or parts of words.

definition: بارودۆخەکێ کو ببیتە ئەگەرێ دروستبوونا فشار و دڵەڕاوکێیێ.
definitionEnglish: Making you feel worried and nervous.

definition: درێژکرنا تشتەکی یان جەستەی ب هێز یان رۆبەرەکێ درێژ یێ عەردی.
definitionEnglish: To cause something to reach, often as far as possible, in a particular direction, or a continuous area of land or water.

definition: کەسەکێ کو یاسایان ب توندی جێبەجێ دکەت یان تشتەکێ کو ب توندی پێگیری پێ دهێتە کرن.
definitionEnglish: Strongly limiting someone's freedom to behave as they wish, or likely to severely punish someone if they do not obey.

definition: ب شێوەیەکێ توند و بێ گوهۆڕین.
definitionEnglish: In a way that would be severe if rules were not obeyed.

definition: هەنگاوەکا درێژ یان پێشکەفتنەکا بەرچاو د کارەکی دا.
definitionEnglish: A long step when walking or running, or an important positive development.

definition: لێدانا تشتەکی ب هێز یان راوەستان ژ کاری بۆ نیشاندانا نەڕازیبوونێ.
definitionEnglish: To hit or attack someone or something, or to refuse to continue working because of an argument with an employer about working conditions, pay levels, or job losses.

definition: تشتەکێ کو ب ئاسانی سەرنجا مروڤی رادکێشیت ژبەر جوانی یان جوداهییێ.
definitionEnglish: Very unusual or easily noticed, and therefore attracting a lot of attention.

definition: پەتەکێ باریک و ب هێز یان زنجیرەیەکا تشتان.
definitionEnglish: (a piece of) strong, thin rope made by twisting very thin threads together, used for fastening and tying things, or a series of related things or events.

meaning: ڕووت کردنەوە / پارچەی باریک / لێ کردنەوە
definition: لێکرنا جلوبەرگان یان پارچەیەکا درێژ و باریک ژ تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: To remove, pull, or tear the covering or outer layer from something, or a long, flat, narrow piece of something.

definition: هێلەکا درێژ یا رەنگەکێ جودا ل سەر روویەکێ.
definitionEnglish: A strip on a surface or object that is a different colour from the surrounding area.

definition: هەولدانەکا زۆر بۆ گەهشتن ب ئارمانجەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To try very hard to do something or to make something happen, especially for a long time or against difficulties.
exampleKurdish: تێکۆشان بۆ گەهشتن ب باشترین ئاست.

definition: نەخۆشیەکا مێشکی یا ژ نشکەکێ ڤە یان دەستپیاهێنانەکا نەرم.
definitionEnglish: A sudden change in the blood supply to a part of the brain, which can cause a loss of the ability to move particular parts of the body, or an act of moving your hand, another part of the body, or an object gently over something or someone.
exampleKurdish: دەستی ب سەر پشیکێ دا بهێنە.

definition: هەبوونا هێزەکا جەستەیی یان مێشکی یا مەزن.
definitionEnglish: Powerful; having or using great force or control.

definition: ب شێوەیەکێ ب هێز یان ب باوەرییەکا توند.
definitionEnglish: In a powerful or convincing way.

definition: تشتەکێ گرێدای ب پێکهاتە یان شێوازێ ئاڤاکرنا تشتەکی ڤە.
definitionEnglish: Relating to the way in which parts of a system or object are arranged.

definition: شێوازێ رێکخستنا پارچەیێن تشتەکی یان ئاڤاهیەکێ مەزن.
definitionEnglish: The way in which the parts of a system or object are arranged or organized, or something that has been made or built from parts, especially a large building.

definition: هەولدانەکا زۆر د ناڤ زەحمەتییان دا بۆ ئەنجامدانا کارەکی.
definitionEnglish: To experience difficulty and make a very great effort in order to do something.

definition: کەسەکێ ل قوتابخانێ یان زانکۆیێ دخوینیت.
definitionEnglish: A person who is learning at a college or university.

definition: ژوورەک بۆ کارکرنا هونەرمەندان یان تۆمارکرنا دەنگ و وێنەیان.
definitionEnglish: A room with special equipment where television or radio programmes or music are recorded and used, or where films are made, or a room where an artist works.

definition: فێربوونا بابەتەکی ب رێکا خواندنێ یان ئەنجامدانا لێکۆلینەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To learn about a subject, especially in an educational course or by reading books, or a detailed investigation and analysis of a subject or situation.

definition: پەیڤەکا گشتی بۆ هەر تشتەکێ کو تو نەخوازێ ناڤێ وی ببیژی.
definitionEnglish: A substance, especially when you do not know or say exactly what it is.

definition: خلیسکانا پێی دەمێ رێڤەچوونێ کو خەریک بیت بکەڤی.
definitionEnglish: To step awkwardly while walking and fall or begin to fall.

definition: سەرسامکرنا کەسەکی ب رادەیەکێ کو نەشێت باخڤیت یان لێدانا کەسەکی هەتا بێهۆش دبیت.
definitionEnglish: To shock or surprise someone very much.

definition: تشتەکێ گەلەک جوان و سەرنجڕاکێش.
definitionEnglish: Extremely beautiful or attractive.

definition: کەسەکێ کو ژیری و زیرەکی تێدا نەبیت.
definitionEnglish: Silly or unwise; showing poor judgment or little intelligence.

definition: شێوازێ ئەنجامدانا تشتەکی یان شێوازێ جلوبەرگ و دیزاینێ.
definitionEnglish: A way of doing something, especially one that is typical of a person, group of people, place, or period.

definition: ئەو تشتێ تو دەربارەی دئاخڤی یان دخوینی یان کەسەکێ ل ژێر دەستهەلاتا کەسەکێ دی.
definitionEnglish: The thing that is being discussed, considered, or studied, or the person or thing that does the action in a sentence.

definition: بیروڕایەکا کو ل سەر هەستێن کەسی هاتیە ئاڤاکرن نەک ل سەر راستییان.
definitionEnglish: Influenced by or based on personal beliefs or feelings, rather than based on facts.

definition: پاپۆرەکا شەری یا کو دشێت ل بن ئاڤێ بچیت.
definitionEnglish: A ship that can travel underwater.

definition: قەبوولکرنا دەستهەلاتا کەسەکێ دی یان پێشکەشکرنا کارەکێ بۆ هەلسەنگاندنێ.
definitionEnglish: The act of giving something for a decision to be made by others, or the act of accepting that someone has defeated you or has power over you.

definition: دانا کارەکی بۆ کەسەکێ دی بۆ وێ چەندێ بڕیارێ ل سەر بدەت.
definitionEnglish: To give or offer something for a decision to be made by others.

definition: کەسەکێ کو پلەیا وی کێمتر بیت ژ کەسەکێ دی د کارەکی دا.
definitionEnglish: Having a lower or less important position.

definition: دانا پارەی ب شێوەیەکێ بەردەوام بۆ وەرگرتنا خزمەتگوزارییەکێ.
definitionEnglish: To pay money to an organization in order to receive a product, use a service regularly, or support the organization.

definition: رێککەفتنەک بۆ وەرگرتنا تشتەکی ب شێوەیەکێ بەردەوام بەرامبەر پارەی.
definitionEnglish: An amount of money that you pay regularly to receive a product or service.

definition: تشتەکێ کو پشتی تشتەکێ دی رویدەت.
definitionEnglish: Happening after something else.

definition: پاشان یان پشتی هنگی.
definitionEnglish: After that.
exampleKurdish: پاشان، ئەو دەست ژ کار کێشایەڤە.

definition: کێمبوونا هێزا تشتەکی یان نزمبوونا ئاستێ ئاڤێ.
definitionEnglish: If a condition subsides, it becomes less strong or extreme.

definition: کۆمپانیەکا بچویک کو یا سەر ب کۆمپانیەکا مەزنتر ڤە بیت.
definitionEnglish: A company that is owned by a larger company.

definition: دانا پارەی ژ لایێ حکومەتێ ڤە بۆ کێمکرنا نرخێ تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: To pay part of the cost of something.

definition: ئەو پارەیێ حکومەت ددەت بۆ هاریکاریکرنا پیشەسازییەکێ یان کێمکرنا نرخان.
definitionEnglish: Money given as part of the cost of something, to help or encourage it to happen.

definition: ماددەیەکێ فیزیکی یێ دیاریکری یان گرنگترین پشکا بابەتەکی.
definitionEnglish: A material with particular physical characteristics.

definition: تشتەکێ کو ب قەبارە یان ب نرخ یێ مەزن و گرنگ بیت.
definitionEnglish: Large in size, value, or importance.

meaning: بە شێوەیەکی بەرچاو / تا ڕادەیەکی زۆر
definition: ب رادەیەکێ مەزن و گرنگ.
definitionEnglish: To a large degree.
exampleKurdish: نرخ ب شێوەیەکێ بەرچاو بلند بوون.

definition: کەسەک یان تشتەکێ کو ل جهێ کەسەک یان تشتەکێ دی دهێتە بکارئینان.
definitionEnglish: A thing or person that is used instead of another thing or person.

definition: کردارا گوهۆڕینا تشتەکی ب تشتەکێ دی.
definitionEnglish: The use of one person or thing instead of another.

definition: تشتەکێ کو ب ئاسانی دیار نەبیت بەلێ یێ گرنگ و جوان بیت.
definitionEnglish: Not loud, bright, noticeable, or obvious in any way.
